notes.title: Mac Support!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we’re very excited to bring you some new massive updates!

The major news is that we’ve added Mac support, we’re working on native Apple Silicon support but at the moment the game runs great on both Intel and Apple Silicon through Rosetta 2.
Adventure In Aellion also supports cross-platform play between Mac and Windows PC so you don’t have to worry about leaving anyone out.
Our work on Mac support has taught us all a great deal and hopefully we’ll be able to use that experience to bring Adventure In Aellion to Linux and other platforms in the near future!

Our next piece of news is that we’ve gone through a major engine upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.27
Because of this the game runs better, has improved lighting and helps to support our work to move the game to one persistent level so players in multiplayer can travel wherever they want without worrying about the level the other players are on!

We’ve been working hard on these updates and we apologise for the time it took to get this update out, creating a Mac version proved quite challenging but we got there. A few supporters have been asking for a project roadmap and that’s something we want to post sooner rather than later. We have had to change our own time estimates due to how much work this new update took. we would definitely like to get the new dungeon in at least a playable “teaser” state for you all by summer, including the persistent level loading.

Thanks once again for your support and we hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Here's our final update of the year in time for the Holidays! We’re bringing you a couple new character customisation options and more fixes as we get ready to launch on new platforms next year!

We're also working on bringing all the dungeons onto one persistent level so that you no longer have to wait for all other players agreeing to move to a new area. This is a difficult process but we're getting there and this will help the world and game play feel drastically more natural.

Hope you have a great Christmas and a happy New Year!

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone Adventure in Aellion has an update adding a new item, the Bottle! Use it to carry potions and more to help you in combat or exploration. We've also added Potion Wells, so you can fill up on the go!

At the moment this is limited to just one Bottle and Health Potion but this update lays the groundwork for adding in more. notes.title: May Update
notes.content:
It's time for our Whiplatch Update focused on improving various player items and interactions in-game!

This month has been about improvements to various tools and other interactive elements based on feedback and further testing while we work on new content. So the Whiplatch will now perform as intended with updated mechanics and UI

Alongside the Whiplatch, there have been other improvements like updating the interactive switches found throughout the world and dungeons of Aellion. This brings them more in line with the aesthetics of the other magical elements within the world as well as being clearer to the player their utility.A dull grey means the switch is inactive and cannot be used. Glowing gold means the switch is ready to be used and a blue glow lets the player know it is in use or has been toggled.

We hope you enjoy the update,
Thank You!

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is our first monthly update of the year and we've focused on Quality Of Life updates and fixes suggested by our community!

Our most notable improvement so far has been the Bow, we've reworked the targeting as well as the animations so now it's much more accurate. Another is a QoL for our Early Access players helping us with feedback, a Level Select option on the Main Menu. When you select the play option you'll have the option to either continue or start a new save, from there you can choose to go to the open world like normal or start in one of our dungeons with the items and gear needed, give it a try if you want to get straight into the action!

Other updates include more details being added to dungeons, enemy AI improvements and many fixes to bugs found by our great players, Thank You!

We're not done yet with just this update, some bugs and improvements will take a bit longer to implement and so our next few updates will focus on polishing what has been built so far while we work in the background on new content for the Spring.

We hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Tweaks, polishes and upgrades!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers, and a happy new year! We hope your festive season was filled with memorable adventures. 

For us, the team at Aellion HQ, the beginning of this year is all about making sure the current dungeons, weapons, creatures and quests in Adventure in Aellion are the best they can be before we add anything brand new. 

We’ve been gathering player feedback throughout our time in Early Access, and a lot of these changes and improvements will be made based on real ideas, changes and thoughts we’ve received from players from our Discord and Steam community! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/a5d4b8e4a382a6c13fa597344073ba5c5ba4b6c9.jpg[/img]
[i]Sharpening the way things look is a big priority for us.[/i]

Over the next few months, you’ll be seeing a lot of quality of life changes, which are improvements we’ll be making to how Adventure in Aellion runs and feels to play, as well as aesthetic changes too. This includes a total overhaul of the game’s lighting which will totally update how the game looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/4e705f2febc5117c61ff6e1d1a54e843578eddb3.jpg[/img]
[i]Lighting can create awesome effects and completely change how a dungeon feels![/i]

As always, we’re incredibly grateful for your support and feedback - if you’ve checked out Adventure in Aellion and have any suggestions you’d like to share, post them below or [url=https://discord.gg/WGv9MMC]join our friendly Discord here[/url].

Now, time for us to get back to work!

- [i]The Adventure in Aellion team[/i]

notes.title: Explore The Ameria Crypts in this month's update!
notes.content:
As the year comes to a close, and before we hang up our adventuring boots for a well-deserved break, we’re introducing an exciting new update full of new gameplay previews and quality of life changes. 

This month, you can preview the deep dark depths of The Ameria Crypts, our brand new dungeon. Hidden below the cathedral in Ameria, the crypts are home to the final resting place of royals, nobles and other important Amerians. The peace of the crypts is disturbed, however, and an evil power has seeped into their eternal sleep and threatens the city above if nothing is done to lay the undead to rest…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/80f4827b0a00faddc9f1166c5805c74d66039eb2.png[/img]
[i]Dark mysteries await in the depths of the Ameria Crypts[/i]

This dungeon introduces a new enemy type - the Undead, who can be slowed and knocked down with mortal weapons but will continue to get back up and fight. The only way to defeat them once and for all is to find a mysterious and powerful weapon hidden deep within the crypts: Lumeria’s Staff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/174c6c5f9ee0b43563cb06f230916011400de10d.png[/img]
[i]Will you find Lumeria’s Staff and harness its power?[/i]

The Ameria Crypts also introduce new gameplay features to enrich your dungeon experience, including ladders and magical switches. We are also hard at work designing the final boss for the dungeon, which you can test your mettle against early next year!

To trial the dungeon preview chat to Farinn, the friendly Vandrmark by the tutorial ruins exit, who will be able to send you on your way. 

For more information about Adventures in Aellion and to keep up to date with our progress, you can join our lovely Discord server. We have a fantastic community, and are always looking to welcome new adventurers! 

Thank you for your continuing support this year, it has been a pleasure sharing our little world with you.

Be careful in the crypts, and Happy Holidays!

[i]The Adventure in Aellion Team
[/i]

notes.title: Alitha Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/b24ea0ff03febc4cbc2cc9eefabf7888f61dc155.png[/img]

Hello everyone, this month we have an over world update to expand the playable area and opened up the Vandr’mark village of Alitha with new characters to talk to and a short side quest to go on as we work out the quest systems going forwards.
This update mainly deals with things behind the scenes such as bug fixes and networking that aren’t super flashy at the minute but will create a better experience going forwards, mostly in service to our end of the year update coming next month!!!

Change log for 0.3.5
• Visit a brand new village to the north, home to our friends the Vandr'mark!
• Meet many new villagers and learn a bit about their culture
• Introducing an early side quest system, talk to the Vandr’mark group next to the river camp and help them on their way.
• Added a helpful NPC called Farinn who will take returning players to certain areas.
• Expanded some NPC dialogue and added some portals to help reach previously accessed areas
• Improved persistence and networking in open world. Objectives already completed in a session should be in the correct state when people join. If we missed anything let us know, currently only in effect in the open world.
• Background work for persistence. Though not fully in yet, we have laid the groundwork for persistence in dungeons so things you do will stay if you leave.
• Known bugs include the Whiplatch and bow as we’re still working on those

As always we look forwards to feedback!

notes.title: Welcome to Alitha!
notes.content:
Welcome to another update adventurers! 

While you have been busy embarking on quests, solving puzzles and fighting monsters, we have been working behind the scenes on some super exciting content and quality of life updates to the game. 

Get ready to explore Alitha, a quaint little village full of big adventures and even bigger secrets! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/ad93cb23cd6d7cddd7b44ac7f943e03204d2a26b.png[/img]
[i]The friendly townsfolk are ready to welcome you![/i]

Alitha will expand the playable area in the game, and introduce a whole host of new characters for you to get to know. As exciting as this is, we’re not done yet! The update will also add a fast travel option for returning players, allowing you to get back to dungeon diving and treasure hunting much easier outside of the tutorial. 

As always, we have also squashed some bugs and tweaked some animations to continue improving your gameplay experience in the world of Aellion. 

Make sure you sharpen your swords and don your best hiking boots because this update is coming out later [b]today[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/d625198d0e3579a40a744e25e6632496d80bfe6c.png[/img]
[i]Where will the roads of Alitha take you?[/i]

If you want to keep up with Adventure in Aellion’s development and see lots of cool behind the scenes stuff, [url=https://t.co/5PGtVPBMYP?amp=1]join our friendly Discord[/url]! Our community is great and we love hearing about your adventures and suggestions! You can also find out more about upcoming features and updates, like the brand new quest system we’re currently working on 👀

Thank you all for your continuing support, we appreciate each and every one of you. 

 - [i]The Adventure in Aellion Team[/i]

notes.content:

Besides those we’ve added plenty of bug fixes and quality of life improvements but we’ll keep on working on these background improvements as they pop up so thanks to all those who have contributed to the game testing channels!

notes.title: Bug fixes & update notes 🐛
notes.content:
Hello there, adventurers! Here's a short update with a few bug fixes and gameplay improvements we've made since our Early Access launch.

[b]Rune Tower[/b]
[list]
[*] Recreated the lift in the Rune Tower, and reworked the operation of the pushable walls to be a much smoother experience
[*] Added an exit to the rune tower, you can now escape and try again later or explore other areas of Aellion!
[*] General performance improvements
[/list]

[b]Gray Temple[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked the Gray Temple lift both visually and mechanically
[*] Improved bomb-able areas in the temple to make them a bit easier to hit
[*] Added a few more torches to help guide you through the temple
[/list]


[b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the weight of bombs, meaning they should now be easier and more precise to control - so you can blow up exactly what you want!
[*] Massively improved controller support
[*] Optimised how dodge works when using a controller
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved how player death operates visually
[*] Reworked the lighting system - the moon will now rise quicker and shine brighter, meaning it won't get as dark in the lands of Aellion!
[*] Fixed several dialogue bugs when chatting to Kodak & Gjork
[/list]


We're incredibly grateful for all our players that have submitted feedback and bug reports since our launch! If you run into any issues while playing Adventure in Aellion, please submit them on our forum or post them [url=http://discord.gg/HAz48zU]on our Discord[/url].

notes.title: Post-Launch News
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/9d4237a8ff2ded123478e0dbe007f0555a99defb.gif[/img]

We've really appreciated all the feedback sent via our Steam community page or [url=https://discord.gg/WGv9MMC]Discord server[/url]!

As always, we're excited that you're here with us on this journey, and we can't wait to show you what's coming next!

- [i]The Adventure in Aellion team[/i]

notes.title: ✨ Adventure in Aellion is out now! ✨
notes.content:

[b]You can buy our open-world fantasy epic right now for £9.99/$9.99! [/b] Check out our launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=p0lSawxBn9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

The adventure doesn't stop there, as we have updates planned for Adventure in Aellion long into the future. We've shared a plan for these additions below - but keep in mind that with every new update, the price may go up. However, as soon as you buy it you get all updates and new content totally for free - so [b]grab it now to make sure you get the best price[/b]!


[h2]The Roadmap of Adventure in Aellion for 2020[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]September[/b]: A brand new boss battle! Bug fixes, and additional combat techniques.
[*] [b]October[/b]: Playable area is expanded to include a new area called 'Alitha Village'. Added lantern mechanics - such as use of fire and oil in and out of combat.
[*] [b]November[/b]: A new dungeon to be added called 'Ameria Crypts' - head out on a quest to stop the undead swarming Aellion and unlock a brand new magical weapon!
[*] [b]December[/b]: This is a month dedicated to bug fixes and player feedback, so if you share your ideas for new mechanics/areas/quests [url= https://discord.gg/WGv9MMC]on our Discord[/url], you may seem them appear in-game in December and onwards! 
[/list]

We're also currently working ensuring Adventure in Aellion runs smoothly on Linux machines - we know this is important to our community so it's a top priority!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/640b68a174dda4446e426fdd641e9b0a4c5fc9aa.gif[/img]

As we've said all along, we couldn't have gotten this far without the awesome support of our community. It's been a tough journey, but we're incredibly proud of what we've made together.

To many more adventure ahead -

-[i] The Adventure in Aellion team[/i]

notes.title: Less than a week to go!
notes.content:
As we head towards our Early Access launch on August 26th - which is less than six days away! - we thought we'd give you a little insight onto how the world of Aellion is shaping up with some brand new screenshots of our latest build! 🕵️‍♂️

Here are some closer looks at not only some new lighting and cosmetic tweaks we've been making, but at what dungeons and areas you'll have to explore at Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/db5666edb8c6eef5bfae19a352c182414ebbe4cd.jpg[/img]
[i]I wonder what (or who) is hiding in this ruin?[/i]

Remember, if you want to check out our free beta ahead of launch, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/WGv9MMC]you can find it on our Discord[/url]! Our lovely community is the first place we go to to share new opportunities to play the game and we love incorporating your ideas into the game. Keep in mind that the beta build is only a glimpse of what we've been working on, there's many more surprises to come in the launch version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/8055c1a405ee15b8b1cc9e0a64fd6c17b486c51c.png[/img]

We first shared these screenshots early with our newsletter readers - [url=bit.ly/advinaellion]make sure to sign-up[/url] to get bi-weekly updates on the game straight to your inbox!

Thank you so much for all of your support so far, we couldn't have done it without you.

See you on August 26th!

- [i]The Adventure in Aellion team[/i]

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hi there, all! We have a big announcement that's been a real tough decision to make, but we feel it's best for the future of Adventure in Aellion.

We're delaying the Early Access launch of the game to [b]August 26th 2020[/b]. This is largely due to making sure we have the time to implement the awesome feedback we've had since launching the public beta. We really want to make sure this game is not only developed by us, but created together as a community.

Our beta build will still be available via our Discord - sign up here: https://discord.gg/WGv9MMC

Thank you all again for your amazing support. If you have any questions about the delay or development, please post them in our Discord server and we'll do our best to answer them!


We're super appreciative of you all, and your time in being part of our community. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/640b68a174dda4446e426fdd641e9b0a4c5fc9aa.gif[/img]

- [b]The Adventure in Aellion team[/b]

notes.title: Development Update - Early Access Approaching!
notes.content:
Hi there, Adventurers!

We want to thank you all for being so awesome - your support of Adventure in Aellion helps us make it the best adventure it can be.

So, in return, we want to keep you in the loop and give you a quick update on how development is going, and how close we are to releasing into Early Access.

Since our first appearance at EGX 2019, we've added to the game...
[list]
[*] A brand new tutorial and brand new location for first-time players
[*] An entirely new dungeon, filled with brand new puzzles to solve!
[*] New weapons, armour and equipment to help you face the dangers of Aellion...
[*] Totally redone artwork, which you can see on our Steam and Twitter pages!
[*] Dynamic animations for combat and exploration
[*] Ecology in monsters and animals - totally reworking how they react to you, and each-other
[/list]

... and that's only the start!

With your support, especially through your help and feedback on our Discord server, Adventure in Aellion is shaping up to be something we're really excited to share with you - s[b]o keep your eyes peeled for an Early Access announcement soon!
[/b]

[h2] Thank you![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34820757/b144d1792aa9d5e705bf0ee4176636256acf84a2.jpg[/img]

So, what's next? Over the next few weeks, we'll be polishing up the game and getting ready to share an entirely new, FREE BETA with you soon. To be the first to know when that launches, [url=https://discord.gg/HAz48zU][b]sign up to our Discord now[/b][/url].

We're always happy to answer any questions you have about Adventure in Aellion, so pop them below or in our feedback channel on the server.

Keep safe, and keep adventuring!

- [i]The Adventure in Aellion team[/i]
